name: Steakhouse USDG
oneLiner: steakUSDG is Steakhouse’s high-yield USDG lending vault on Robinhood Chain, with yield-accruing shares exposed to borrower losses and withdrawal liquidity.
collateral: USDG held idle in the exact Morpho VaultV2 and supplied through its sole MorphoMarketV1 adapter; borrower collateral and market liquidity determine strategy risk.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a proportional USDG-denominated lending position. Interest and fee-share accrual change assets per share; bad debt reduces NAV. Holder withdrawals burn shares and pay USDG atomically when idle assets plus the selected liquidity adapter suffice. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The holder claim is the operational ERC-4626 claim at robinhood:0xbeeff033f34c046626b8d0a041844c5d1a5409dd, not direct ownership of the parent’s fiat reserves. At block 89162029 (2026-10-15T10:43:17Z), deployed runtime exactly matches the verified immutable VaultV2 source. User issuance transfers underlying before creating shares, interest accrual can mint fee shares, and redemption burns receipts against available underlying. Parent fiat-cash protections remain upstream.

notices.title: Morpho flags deposits as disabled
notices.message: On 15 October 2026, the exact Morpho vault page and API reported deposits disabled. This does not establish a withdrawal suspension. Existing holders still depend on available USDG market liquidity to redeem.
